description:
Formatea un monto en cualquier moneda ISO 4217 según el idioma/país (símbolo, código o nombre), con sus decimales estándar. Cuándo: un cálculo de dinero, impuestos o matemática financiera tiene que ser exacto y reproducible (redondeo, centavos, tasas). No para: formatear un valor en pesos colombianos (co-cop-format). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Formats an amount in any ISO 4217 currency for a locale via Intl (symbol, narrow symbol, code or name), using the currency's standard minor units unless overridden, and accounting style for negatives. When: a money, tax or financial-math result has to be exact and reproducible (rounding, cents, rates). Not for: formatting an amount as Colombian pesos the way it is written in Colombia (co-cop-format). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Formats an amount in any ISO 4217 currency for a locale via Intl (symbol, narrow symbol, code or name), using the currency's standard minor units unless overridden, and accounting style for negatives. When: a money, tax or financial-math result has to be exact and reproducible (rounding, cents, rates). Not for: formatting an amount as Colombian pesos the way it is written in Colombia (co-cop-format). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

accounting.description: Parentheses for negatives (boolean; optional; default false).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (string; optional; default "USD"; pattern ^[A-Za-z]{3}$).

display.description: Currency display (optional; one of: symbol, narrowSymbol, code, name; default "symbol").

locale.description: BCP 47 locale (string; optional; default "en-US"; up to 35 chars; pattern ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*$).

name: currency-format
title: Formatear moneda por país
